ayahs.ar: طٰهٰ
ayahs.tl: Taa-Haa
ayahs.en: Ta, Ha.

ayahs.ar: مَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِتَشۡقٰ٘يۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Maaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Qur-aana litashqaaa
ayahs.en: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةً لِّمَنۡ يَّخۡشٰيۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Illaa tazkiratal limany yakshaa
ayahs.en: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -

ayahs.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلًا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَرۡضَ وَالسَّمٰوٰتِ الۡعُلٰيؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Tanzeelam mimman khalaqal arda was samaawaatil 'ulaa
ayahs.en: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,

ayahs.ar: اَلرَّحۡمٰنُ عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِ اسۡتَوٰي
ayahs.tl: Ar-Rahmaanu 'alal 'Arshis tawaa
ayahs.en: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.

ayahs.ar: لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ الثَّرٰي
ayahs.tl: Lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa maa tahtassaraa
ayahs.en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ تَجۡهَرۡ بِالۡقَوۡلِ فَاِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ السِّرَّ وَاَخۡفٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa in tajhar bilqawli fainnahoo ya'lamus sirra wa akhfaa
ayahs.en: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ لَهُ الۡاَسۡمَآءُ الۡحُسۡنٰي
ayahs.tl: Allaahu laaa ilasha illaa Huwa lahul Asmaaa'ul Husnaa
ayahs.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.

ayahs.ar: وَهَلۡ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيۡثُ مُوۡسٰيۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa hal ataaka hadeesu Moosa
ayahs.en: And has the story of Moses reached you? -

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ رَاٰ نَارًا فَقَالَ لِاَهۡلِهِ امۡكُثُوۡ٘ا اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰنَسۡتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّيۡ٘ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوۡ اَجِدُ عَلَي النَّارِ هُدًي
ayahs.tl: Iz ra aa naaran faqaala li alhlihim kusooo inneee aanastu naaral la'alleee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu 'alan naari hudaa
ayahs.en: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَتٰىهَا نُوۡدِيَ يٰمُوۡسٰيؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa ataahaa noodiya yaa Moosaa
ayahs.en: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَۚ اِنَّكَ بِالۡوَادِ الۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًيؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Inneee Ana Rabbuka fakhla' na'laika innaka bilwaadil muqaddasi Tuwaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنَا اخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَاسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوۡحٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa anakhtartuka fastami' limaa yoohaa
ayahs.en: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].

ayahs.ar: اِنَّنِيۡ٘ اَنَا اللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنَا فَاعۡبُدۡنِيۡۙ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِذِكۡرِيۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaneee Anal laahu laaa ilaaha illaa Ana fa'budnee wa aqimis-salaata lizikree
ayahs.en: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِيَةٌ اَكَادُ اُخۡفِيۡهَا لِتُجۡزٰي كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۭ بِمَا تَسۡعٰي
ayahs.tl: Innas Saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa tas'aa
ayahs.en: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَنۡ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ فَتَرۡدٰي
ayahs.tl: Falaa yasuddannnaka 'anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa
ayahs.en: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِيۡنِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa maa tilka bi yamee nika yaa Moosaa
ayahs.en: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَۚ اَتَوَكَّؤُا عَلَيۡهَا وَاَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلٰي غَنَمِيۡ وَلِيَ فِيۡهَا مَاٰرِبُ اُخۡرٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala hiya 'asaaya atawakka'u alaihaa wa ahushshu bihaa 'alaa ghanamee wa liya feehaa ma aaribu ukhraa
ayahs.en: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَلۡقِهَا يٰمُوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala alqihaa yaa Moosaa
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."

ayahs.ar: فَاَلۡقٰىهَا فَاِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسۡعٰي
ayahs.tl: Fa-alqaahaa fa -izaa hiya haiyatun tas'aa
ayahs.en: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡࣞ سَنُعِيۡدُهَا سِيۡرَتَهَا الۡاُوۡلٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala khuzhaa wa laa ta khaf sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal oolaa
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.

ayahs.ar: وَاضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ اِلٰي جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوۡٓءٍ اٰيَةً اُخۡرٰيۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairi sooo'in Aayatan ukhraa
ayahs.en: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,

ayahs.ar: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا الۡكُبۡرٰيۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Linuriyaka min Aayaatinal Kubra
ayahs.en: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡهَبۡ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰيࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Izhab ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa
ayahs.en: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اشۡرَحۡ لِيۡ صَدۡرِيۡۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbish rah lee sadree
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]

ayahs.ar: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيۡ٘ اَمۡرِيۡۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yassir leee amree
ayahs.en: And ease for me my task

ayahs.ar: وَاحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةً مِّنۡ لِّسَانِيۡۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wahlul 'uqdatam milli saanee
ayahs.en: And untie the knot from my tongue

ayahs.ar: يَفۡقَهُوۡا قَوۡلِيۡࣕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yafqahoo qawlee
ayahs.en: That they may understand my speech.

ayahs.ar: وَاجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ وَزِيۡرًا مِّنۡ اَهۡلِيۡۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Waj'al lee wazeeram min ahlee
ayahs.en: And appoint for me a minister from my family -

ayahs.ar: هٰرُوۡنَ اَخِيۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Haaroona akhee
ayahs.en: Aaron, my brother.

ayahs.ar: اشۡدُدۡ بِهٖ٘ اَزۡرِيۡۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Ushdud biheee azree
ayahs.en: Increase through him my strength

ayahs.ar: وَاَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيۡ٘ اَمۡرِيۡۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ashrik hu feee amree
ayahs.en: And let him share my task

ayahs.ar: كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيۡرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Kai nusabbihaka kaseeraa
ayahs.en: That we may exalt You much

ayahs.ar: وَّنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيۡرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa nazkuraka kaseeraa
ayahs.en: And remember You much.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكَ كُنۡتَ بِنَا بَصِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Innaka kunta binaa baseeraa
ayahs.en: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ قَدۡ اُوۡتِيۡتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala qad ooteeta su'laka yaa Moosaa
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً اُخۡرٰ٘يۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad manannaa 'alaika marratan ukhraaa
ayahs.en: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اُمِّكَ مَا يُوۡحٰ٘يۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz awhainaaa ilaaa ummika maa yoohaaa
ayahs.en: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,

ayahs.ar: اَنِ اقۡذِفِيۡهِ فِي التَّابُوۡتِ فَاقۡذِفِيۡهِ فِي الۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ الۡيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَاۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّيۡ وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهٗؕ وَاَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّيۡ ࣢ۚ وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلٰي عَيۡنِيۡۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Aniqzifeehi fit Taabooti faqzifeehi fil yammi fal yul qihil yammu bis saahili yaakhuzhu 'aduwwul lee wa 'aduwwul lah; wa alqaitu 'alaika mahabbatam minnee wa litusna'a 'alaa 'ainee
ayahs.en: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ تَمۡشِيۡ٘ اُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُوۡلُ هَلۡ اَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلٰي مَنۡ يَّكۡفُلُهٗؕ فَرَجَعۡنٰكَ اِلٰ٘ي اُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ ࣢ؕ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسًا فَنَجَّيۡنٰكَ مِنَ الۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنّٰكَ فُتُوۡنًا ࣢ࣞ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِيۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ࣢ۙ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلٰي قَدَرٍ يّٰمُوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Iz tamsheee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum 'alaa mai yakfuluhoo faraja 'naaka ilaaa ummika kai taqarra 'ainuhaa wa laa tahzan; wa qatalta nafsan fanajjainaaka minal ghammi wa fatannaaka futoonaa; falabista sineena feee ahli Madyana summa ji'ta 'alaa qadariny yaa Moosa
ayahs.en: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.

ayahs.ar: وَاصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِيۡۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wastana' tuka linafsee
ayahs.en: And I produced you for Myself.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡهَبۡ اَنۡتَ وَاَخُوۡكَ بِاٰيٰتِيۡ وَلَا تَنِيَا فِيۡ ذِكۡرِيۡۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Izhab anta wa akhooka bi Aayaatee wa laa taniyaa fee zikree
ayahs.en: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡهَبَا٘ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰيۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Izhabaaa ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa
ayahs.en: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

ayahs.ar: فَقُوۡلَا لَهٗ قَوۡلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهٗ يَتَذَكَّرُ اَوۡ يَخۡشٰي
ayahs.tl: Faqoolaa lahoo qawlal laiyinal la allahoo yatazakkkaru 'aw yakhshaa
ayahs.en: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَا٘ اِنَّنَا نَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَا٘ اَوۡ اَنۡ يَّطۡغٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaalaa Rabbanaaa innanaa nakhaafu ai yafruta 'alainaaa aw ai yatghaa
ayahs.en: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا٘ اِنَّنِيۡ مَعَكُمَا٘ اَسۡمَعُ وَاَرٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala laa takhaafaaa innanee ma'akumaa asma'u wa araa
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

ayahs.ar: فَاۡتِيٰهُ فَقُوۡلَا٘ اِنَّا رَسُوۡلَا رَبِّكَ فَاَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ ࣢ۙ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡؕ قَدۡ جِئۡنٰكَ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَؕ وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلٰي مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الۡهُدٰي
ayahs.tl: Faatiyaahu faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolaa Rabbika fa arsil ma'anaa Banee Israaa'eela wa laa tu'azzibhum qad ji'naaka bi Aayatim mir Rabbika wassa laamu 'alaa manit taba'al hudaa
ayahs.en: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا قَدۡ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡنَا٘ اَنَّ الۡعَذَابَ عَلٰي مَنۡ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّٰي
ayahs.tl: Innaa qad oohiya ilainaaa annnal 'azaaba 'alaa man kaz zaba wa tawalla
ayahs.en: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَنۡ رَّبُّكُمَا يٰمُوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala famar Rabbu kumaa yaa Moosa
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِيۡ٘ اَعۡطٰي كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهٗ ثُمَّ هَدٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbunal lazeee a'taa kulla shai'in khalqahoo summa hadaa
ayahs.en: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الۡقُرُوۡنِ الۡاُوۡلٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala famaa baalul quroonil oolaa
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِنۡدَ رَبِّيۡ فِيۡ كِتٰبٍۚ لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّيۡ وَلَا يَنۡسَيؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala 'ilmuhaa 'inda Rabee fee kitaab, laa yadillu Rabbee wa laa yansaa
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مَهۡدًا وَّسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبُلًا وَّاَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًؕ فَاَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡ نَّبَاتٍ شَتّٰي
ayahs.tl: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw wa salaka lakum feehaa subulanw wa anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa akhrajnaa biheee azwaajam min nabaatin shatta
ayahs.en: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.

ayahs.ar: كُلُوۡا وَارۡعَوۡا اَنۡعَامَكُمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِي النُّهٰيࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Kuloo war'aw an'aamakum; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil li ulin nuhaa
ayahs.en: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.

ayahs.ar: مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ وَفِيۡهَا نُعِيۡدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً اُخۡرٰي
ayahs.tl: Minhaa khalaqnaakum wa feehaa nu'eedukum wa minhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa
ayahs.en: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرَيۡنٰهُ اٰيٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَاَبٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arainaahu Aayaatinaa kullahaa fakaz zaba wa abaa
ayahs.en: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ اَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala aji'tanaa litukhri janaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaa Moosa
ayahs.en: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

ayahs.ar: فَلَنَاۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ فَاجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدًا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهٗ نَحۡنُ وَلَا٘ اَنۡتَ مَكَانًا سُوًي
ayahs.tl: Falanaatiyannaka bisihrim mislihee faj'al bainanaa wa bainaka maw'idal laa nukhlifuhoo nahnu wa laaa anta makaanan suwaa
ayahs.en: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ الزِّيۡنَةِ وَاَنۡ يُّحۡشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًي
ayahs.tl: Qaala maw'idukum yawmuz zeenati wa ai yuhsharan naasu duhaa
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلّٰي فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهٗ ثُمَّ اَتٰي
ayahs.tl: Fatawallaa Fir'awnu fajjama'a kaidahoo summa ataa
ayahs.en: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰي وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسۡحِتَكُمۡ بِعَذَابٍۚ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ افۡتَرٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala lahum Moosaa wailakum laa taftaroo 'alal laahi kaziban fa yus hitakum bi 'azaab, wa qad khaaba manif taraa
ayahs.en: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."

ayahs.ar: فَتَنَازَعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجۡوٰي
ayahs.tl: Fatanaaza'ooo amrahum bainahum wa asarrun najwaa
ayahs.en: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ هٰذٰنِ لَسٰحِرٰنِ يُرِيۡدٰنِ اَنۡ يُّخۡرِجٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِكُمۡ بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيۡقَتِكُمُ الۡمُثۡلٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo in haaazaani lasaahiraani yureedaani ai yukhrijaakum min ardikum bisihrihimaa wa yazhabaa bitareeqatikumul muslaa
ayahs.en: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.

ayahs.ar: فَاَجۡمِعُوۡا كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ائۡتُوۡا صَفًّاۚ وَقَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ الۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ اسۡتَعۡلٰي
ayahs.tl: Fa ajmi'oo kaidakum summma'too saffaa; wa qad aflahal yawma manis ta'laa
ayahs.en: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِمَّا٘ اَنۡ تُلۡقِيَ وَاِمَّا٘ اَنۡ نَّكُوۡنَ اَوَّلَ مَنۡ اَلۡقٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa Moosaaa immaaa an tulqiya wa immaaa an nakoona awala man alqaa
ayahs.en: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ اَلۡقُوۡاۚ فَاِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ اِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ سِحۡرِهِمۡ اَنَّهَا تَسۡعٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala bal alqoo fa izaa hibaaluhum wa 'isiyyuhum yuhaiyalu ilaihi min sihrihim annahaa tas'aa
ayahs.en: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].

ayahs.ar: فَاَوۡجَسَ فِيۡ نَفۡسِهٖ خِيۡفَةً مُّوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Fa awjasa fee nafsihee kheefatam Moosa
ayahs.en: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡاَعۡلٰي
ayahs.tl: Qulnaa laa takhaf innaka antal a'laa
ayahs.en: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.

ayahs.ar: وَاَلۡقِ مَا فِيۡ يَمِيۡنِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوۡاؕ اِنَّمَا صَنَعُوۡا كَيۡدُ سٰحِرٍؕ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ اَتٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa alqi maa fee yamee nika talqaf maa sana'oo; innamaa sana'oo kaidu saahir; wa laa yuflihus saahiru haisu ataa
ayahs.en: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."

ayahs.ar: فَاُلۡقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هٰرُوۡنَ وَمُوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Fa ulqiyas saharatu sujjadan qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbi Haaroona wa Moosa
ayahs.en: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَكُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيۡرُكُمُ الَّذِيۡ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحۡرَۚ فَلَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَكُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِيۡ جُذُوۡعِ النَّخۡلِؗ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ اَيُّنَا٘ اَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَّاَبۡقٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum; innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'allama kumus sihra fala uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibannakum fee juzoo'in nakhli wa lata'lamunna aiyunaaa ashaddu 'azaabanw wa abqaa
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا لَنۡ نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلٰي مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ الۡبَيِّنٰتِ وَالَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنَا فَاقۡضِ مَا٘ اَنۡتَ قَاضٍؕ اِنَّمَا تَقۡضِيۡ هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo lan nu'siraka 'alaa maa jaaa'anaa minal baiyinaati wallazee fataranaa faqdi maaa anta qaad; innamaa taqdee haazihil hayaatad dunyaa
ayahs.en: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغۡفِرَ لَنَا خَطٰيٰنَا وَمَا٘ اَكۡرَهۡتَنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ السِّحۡرِؕ وَاللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰي
ayahs.tl: Innaaa aamannaa bi Rabbinaa liyaghfira lanaa khataayaanaa wa maaa akrahtanaa 'alaihi minas sihr; wallaahu khairunw waabqaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّهٗ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِ رَبَّهٗ مُجۡرِمًا فَاِنَّ لَهٗ جَهَنَّمَؕ لَا يَمُوۡتُ فِيۡهَا وَلَا يَحۡيٰي
ayahs.tl: Innahoo mai yaati Rabbahoo mujriman fa inna lahoo Jahannama laa yamotu feehaa wa laa yahyaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّاۡتِهٖ مُؤۡمِنًا قَدۡ عَمِلَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجٰتُ الۡعُلٰيۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa mai yaatihee mu'minan qad 'amilas saalihaati fa ulaaa'ika lahumud dara jaatul 'ulaa
ayahs.en: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:

ayahs.ar: جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ وَذٰلِكَ جَزٰٓؤُا مَنۡ تَزَكّٰيࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Jannaatu 'Adnin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa; wa zaalika jazaaa'ua man tazakka
ayahs.en: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي ࣢ۙ اَنۡ اَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيۡ فَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيۡقًا فِي الۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسًاۙ لَّا تَخٰفُ دَرَكًا وَّلَا تَخۡشٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadee fadrib lahum tareeqan fil bahri yabasal laa takhaafu darakanw wa laa takhshaa
ayahs.en: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."

ayahs.ar: فَاَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُوۡدِهٖ فَغَشِيَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa atba'ahum Fir'awnu bijunoodihee faghashiyahum minal yammmi maa ghashi yahum
ayahs.en: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,

ayahs.ar: وَاَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهٗ وَمَا هَدٰي
ayahs.tl: wa adalla fir'awnu qawmahoo wa maa hadaa
ayahs.en: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ قَدۡ اَنۡجَيۡنٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوٰعَدۡنٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ الطُّوۡرِ الۡاَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡمَنَّ وَالسَّلۡوٰي
ayahs.tl: Yaa Baneee Israaa'eela qad anjainaakum min 'aduw wikum wa wa'adnaakum jaanibat Tooril aimana wa nazzalnaa 'alaikumul Manna was Salwaa
ayahs.en: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,

ayahs.ar: كُلُوۡا مِنۡ طَيِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡا فِيۡهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِيۡۚ وَمَنۡ يَّحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِيۡ فَقَدۡ هَوٰي
ayahs.tl: Kuloo min taiyibaati maa razaqnaakum wa laa tatghaw feehi fa yahilla 'alaikum ghadabee wa mai yahlil 'alaihi ghadabee faqad hawaa
ayahs.en: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."

ayahs.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهۡتَدٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa innee la Ghaffaarul liman taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan summah tadaa
ayahs.en: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَعۡجَلَكَ عَنۡ قَوۡمِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa a'jalaka 'an qawmika yaa Moosa
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هُمۡ اُولَآءِ عَلٰ٘ي اَثَرِيۡ وَعَجِلۡتُ اِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala hum ulaaa'i 'alaaa asaree wa 'ajiltu ilaika Rabbi litardaa
ayahs.en: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّا قَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَوۡمَكَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِكَ وَاَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِيُّ
ayahs.tl: Qaala fa innaa qad fatannaa qawmaka mim ba'dika wa adallahumus Saamiriyy
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."

ayahs.ar: فَرَجَعَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ غَضۡبَانَ اَسِفًا ࣢ۚ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَلَمۡ يَعِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًا ࣢ؕ اَفَطَالَ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡعَهۡدُ اَمۡ اَرَدۡتُّمۡ اَنۡ يَّحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ فَاَخۡلَفۡتُمۡ مَّوۡعِدِيۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Faraja's Moosaaa ilaa qawmihee ghadbaana asifaa; qaala yaa qawmi alam ya'idkum Rabbukum wa'dan hasanaa; afataala 'alaikumul 'ahdu am arattum ai yahilla 'alaikum ghadabum mir Rabbikum fa akhlaftum maw'idee
ayahs.en: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا مَا٘ اَخۡلَفۡنَا مَوۡعِدَكَ بِمَلۡكِنَا وَلٰكِنَّا حُمِّلۡنَا٘ اَوۡزَارًا مِّنۡ زِيۡنَةِ الۡقَوۡمِ فَقَذَفۡنٰهَا فَكَذٰلِكَ اَلۡقَي السَّامِرِيُّۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo maaa akhlafnaa maw'idaka bimalkinna wa laakinna hummilnaaa awzaaram min zeenatil qawmi faqazafnaahaa fakazaalika alqas Saamiriyy
ayahs.en: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."

ayahs.ar: فَاَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلًا جَسَدًا لَّهٗ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوۡا هٰذَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ وَاِلٰهُ مُوۡسٰي ࣢ۙۚ فَنَسِيَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa akhraja lahum 'ijlan jasadal lahoo khuwaarun faqaaloo haazaaa ilaahukum wa ilaahu Moosaa fanasee
ayahs.en: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."

ayahs.ar: اَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ اَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ اِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلًا ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفۡعًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Afalaa yarawna allaa yarji'u ilaihim qawlanw wa laa yamliku lahum darranw wa laa naf'aa
ayahs.en: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ هٰرُوۡنُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنَّمَا فُتِنۡتُمۡ بِهٖۚ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ فَاتَّبِعُوۡنِيۡ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرِيۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad qaala lahum Haaroonu min qablu yaa qawmi innamaa futintum bihee wa inna Rabbakumur Rahmaanu fattabi'oonee wa atee'ooo amree
ayahs.en: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا لَنۡ نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عٰكِفِيۡنَ حَتّٰي يَرۡجِعَ اِلَيۡنَا مُوۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo lan nabraha 'alaihi 'aakifeena hattaa yarji'a ilainaa Moosaa
ayahs.en: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰهٰرُوۡنُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اِذۡ رَاَيۡتَهُمۡ ضَلُّوۡ٘اۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala Yaa Haaroonu maa mana 'aka iz ra aitahum dallooo
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,

ayahs.ar: اَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِؕ اَفَعَصَيۡتَ اَمۡرِيۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Allaa tattabi'ani afa'asaita amree
ayahs.en: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَبۡنَؤُمَّ لَا تَاۡخُذۡ بِلِحۡيَتِيۡ وَلَا بِرَاۡسِيۡۚ اِنِّيۡ خَشِيۡتُ اَنۡ تَقُوۡلَ فَرَّقۡتَ بَيۡنَ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ وَلَمۡ تَرۡقُبۡ قَوۡلِيۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala yabna'umma laa taakhuz bilihyatee wa laa biraasee innee khashetu an taqoola farraqta baina Baneee Israaa'eela wa lam tarqub qawlee
ayahs.en: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكَ يٰسَامِرِيُّ
ayahs.tl: Qaala famaa khatbuka yaa Saamiriyy
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَصُرۡتُ بِمَا لَمۡ يَبۡصُرُوۡا بِهٖ فَقَبَضۡتُ قَبۡضَةً مِّنۡ اَثَرِ الرَّسُوۡلِ فَنَبَذۡتُهَا وَكَذٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتۡ لِيۡ نَفۡسِيۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala basurtu bimaa lam yabsuroo bihee faqabadtu qabdatam min asarir Rasooli fanabaztuhaa wa kazaalika sawwalat lee nafsee
ayahs.en: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاذۡهَبۡ فَاِنَّ لَكَ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ اَنۡ تَقُوۡلَ لَا مِسَاسَࣕ وَاِنَّ لَكَ مَوۡعِدًا لَّنۡ تُخۡلَفَهٗۚ وَانۡظُرۡ اِلٰ٘ي اِلٰهِكَ الَّذِيۡ ظَلۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ عَاكِفًاؕ لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَنۡسِفَنَّهٗ فِي الۡيَمِّ نَسۡفًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala fazhab fa inna laka fil hayaati an taqoola laa misaasa wa inna laka maw'idal lan tukhlafahoo wanzur ilaaa ilaahikal lazee zalta 'alaihi 'aakifaa; lanuharriqannnahoo summa lanansifanahoo fil yammi nasfaa
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمًا
ayahs.tl: Innamaaa ilaahukkumul laahul lazee laa ilaaha illaa Hoo; wasi'a kulla shai'in ilmaa
ayahs.en: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ مَا قَدۡ سَبَقَۚ وَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنٰكَ مِنۡ لَّدُنَّا ذِكۡرًاۖۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Kazaalika naqussu 'alaika min ambaaa'i maa qad sabaq; wa qad aatainaaka mil ladunnaa Zikraa
ayahs.en: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ اَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهُ فَاِنَّهٗ يَحۡمِلُ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وِزۡرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Man a'rada 'anhu, fa innahoo yahmilu Yawmal Qiyaamati wizraa
ayahs.en: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,

ayahs.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهِؕ وَسَآءَ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ حِمۡلًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Khaalideena feehi wa saaa'a lahum Yawmal Qiyaamati himlaa
ayahs.en: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -

ayahs.ar: يَّوۡمَ يُنۡفَخُ فِي الصُّوۡرِ وَنَحۡشُرُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ زُرۡقًاۚۖۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yawma yunfakhu fissoori wa nahshurul mujrimeena Yawma 'izin zurqaa
ayahs.en: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.

ayahs.ar: يَّتَخَافَتُوۡنَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا عَشۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Yatakhaafatoona bainahum il labistum illaa 'ashraa
ayahs.en: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."

ayahs.ar: نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِذۡ يَقُوۡلُ اَمۡثَلُهُمۡ طَرِيۡقَةً اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا يَوۡمًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona iz yaqoolu amsaluhum tareeqatan illabistum illaa yawmaa
ayahs.en: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."

ayahs.ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنِ الۡجِبَالِ فَقُلۡ يَنۡسِفُهَا رَبِّيۡ نَسۡفًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yas'aloonaka 'anil jibaali faqul yansifuhaa Rabbee nasfaa
ayahs.en: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.

ayahs.ar: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفۡصَفًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa yazaruhaa qaa'an safsafaa
ayahs.en: And He will leave the earth a level plain;

ayahs.ar: لَّا تَرٰي فِيۡهَا عِوَجًا وَّلَا٘ اَمۡتًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Laa taraa feehaa 'iwajanw wa laaa amtaa
ayahs.en: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّتَّبِعُوۡنَ الدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهٗۚ وَخَشَعَتِ الۡاَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ فَلَا تَسۡمَعُ اِلَّا هَمۡسًا
ayahs.tl: Yawma iziny yattabi'oonad daa'iya laa 'iwaja lahoo wa khasha'atil aswaatu lir Rahmaani falaa tasma'u illaa hamsaa
ayahs.en: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنۡفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ اِلَّا مَنۡ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهٗ قَوۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Yawma 'izil laa tanfa'ush shafaa'atu illaa man azina lahur Rahmaanu wa radiya lahoo qawlaa
ayahs.en: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.

ayahs.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِيۡطُوۡنَ بِهٖ عِلۡمًا
ayahs.tl: Ya'lamu maa bainaa aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yauheetoona bihee 'ilmaa
ayahs.en: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge.

ayahs.ar: وَعَنَتِ الۡوُجُوۡهُ لِلۡحَيِّ الۡقَيُّوۡمِؕ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ حَمَلَ ظُلۡمًا
ayahs.tl: Wa 'anatil wujoohu lil Haiiyil Qaiyoomi wa qad khaaba man hamala zulmaa
ayahs.en: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَلَا يَخٰفُ ظُلۡمًا وَّلَا هَضۡمًا
ayahs.tl: Wa mai ya'mal minas saalihaati wa huwa mu'minun falaa yakhaafu zulmanw wa laa hadmaa
ayahs.en: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا وَّصَرَّفۡنَا فِيۡهِ مِنَ الۡوَعِيۡدِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُوۡنَ اَوۡ يُحۡدِثُ لَهُمۡ ذِكۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika anzalnaahu Qur-aanan 'Arabiyyanw wa sarrafnaa fee hi minal wa'eedi la'allahum yattaqoona aw yuhdisu lahum zikraa
ayahs.en: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.

ayahs.ar: فَتَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ الۡمَلِكُ الۡحَقُّۚ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِالۡقُرۡاٰنِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يُّقۡضٰ٘ي اِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهٗؗ وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ زِدۡنِيۡ عِلۡمًا
ayahs.tl: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; wa laa ta'jal bil Quraani min qabli ai yuqdaaa ilaika wahyuhoo wa qur Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa
ayahs.en: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَهِدۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اٰدَمَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمۡ نَجِدۡ لَهٗ عَزۡمًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad 'ahidnaaa ilaaa Aadama min qablu fanasiya wa lam najid lahoo 'azmaa
ayahs.en: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اَبٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qulnaa lilma laaa'ikatis judoo li Aadama fasajadooo illaaa Iblees; abaa
ayahs.en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.

ayahs.ar: فَقُلۡنَا يٰ٘اٰدَمُ اِنَّ هٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوۡجِكَ فَلَا يُخۡرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الۡجَنَّةِ فَتَشۡقٰي
ayahs.tl: Faqulnaa yaaa Aadamu inna haazaa 'aduwwul laka wa lizawjika falaa yukhrijan nakumaa minal Jannati fatashqaa
ayahs.en: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ لَكَ اَلَّا تَجُوۡعَ فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَعۡرٰيۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa laka allaa tajoo'a feeha wa laa ta'raa
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنَّكَ لَا تَظۡمَؤُا فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَضۡحٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa annaka laa tazma'u feehaa wa laa tadhaa
ayahs.en: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."

ayahs.ar: فَوَسۡوَسَ اِلَيۡهِ الشَّيۡطٰنُ قَالَ يٰ٘اٰدَمُ هَلۡ اَدُلُّكَ عَلٰي شَجَرَةِ الۡخُلۡدِ وَمُلۡكٍ لَّا يَبۡلٰي
ayahs.tl: Fa waswasa ilaihish Shaitaanu qaala yaaa Aadamu hal adulluka 'alaa shajaratil khuldi wa mulkil laa yablaa
ayahs.en: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"

ayahs.ar: فَاَكَلَا مِنۡهَا فَبَدَتۡ لَهُمَا سَوۡاٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخۡصِفٰنِ عَلَيۡهِمَا مِنۡ وَّرَقِ الۡجَنَّةِؗ وَعَصٰ٘ي اٰدَمُ رَبَّهٗ فَغَوٰيࣕۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa akalaa minhaa fabadat lahumaa saw aatuhumaa wa tafiqaa yakhsifaani 'alaihimaa minw waraqil jannah; wa 'asaaa Aadamu Rabbahoo faghawaa
ayahs.en: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اجۡتَبٰهُ رَبُّهٗ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِ وَهَدٰي
ayahs.tl: Summaj tabbahu Rabbuhoo fataaba 'alaihi wa hadaa
ayahs.en: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اهۡبِطَا مِنۡهَا جَمِيۡعًاۭ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّۚ فَاِمَّا يَاۡتِيَنَّكُمۡ مِّنِّيۡ هُدًي ࣢ۙ فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشۡقٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaalah bita minhaa jamee'am ba'dukum liba'din 'aduww; fa immaa yaati yannakum minnee hudan famanit taba'a hudaaya falaa yadillu wa laa yashhqaa
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ اَعۡرَضَ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِيۡ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ مَعِيۡشَةً ضَنۡكًا وَّنَحۡشُرُهٗ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ اَعۡمٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa man a'rada 'an Zikree fa inna lahoo ma'eeshatan dankanw wa nahshuruhoo Yawmal Qiyaamati a'maa
ayahs.en: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرۡتَنِيۡ٘ اَعۡمٰي وَقَدۡ كُنۡتُ بَصِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi lima hashar tanee a'maa wa qad kuntu baseeraa
ayahs.en: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اَتَتۡكَ اٰيٰتُنَا فَنَسِيۡتَهَاۚ وَكَذٰلِكَ الۡيَوۡمَ تُنۡسٰي
ayahs.tl: Qaala kazaalika atatka Aayaatunaa fanaseetahaa wa kazaalikal Yawma tunsaa
ayahs.en: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيۡ مَنۡ اَسۡرَفَ وَلَمۡ يُؤۡمِنۭۡ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَشَدُّ وَاَبۡقٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika najzee man asrafa wa lam yu'mim bi Aayaati Rabbih; wa la'azaabul Aakhirati ashaddu wa abqaa
ayahs.en: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.

ayahs.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ يَمۡشُوۡنَ فِيۡ مَسٰكِنِهِمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِي النُّهٰيࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa qablahum minal qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil li ulinnuhaa
ayahs.en: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَّاَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّيؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law laa Kalimatun sabaqat mir Rabbika lakaana lizaamanw wa ajalum musammaa
ayahs.en: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].

ayahs.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوۡعِ الشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ غُرُوۡبِهَاۚ وَمِنۡ اٰنَآئِ الَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡ وَاَطۡرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرۡضٰي
ayahs.tl: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi wa qabla ghuroobihaa wa min aanaaa'il laili fasbbih wa atraafan nahaari la 'allaka tardaa
ayahs.en: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ اِلٰي مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡهُمۡ زَهۡرَةَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا ࣢ۙ لِنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيۡهِؕ وَرِزۡقُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tamuddanna 'ainaika ilaa ma matta'na biheee azwajam minhum zahratal hayaatid dunya linaftinahum feeh; wa rizqu Rabbika khairunw wa abqaa
ayahs.en: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

ayahs.ar: وَاۡمُرۡ اَهۡلَكَ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَاصۡطَبِرۡ عَلَيۡهَاؕ لَا نَسۡـَٔلُكَ رِزۡقًاؕ نَحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكَؕ وَالۡعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقۡوٰي
ayahs.tl: Waamur ahlaka bis Salaati wastabir 'alaihaa la nas'aluka rizqaa; nahnu narzuquk; wal 'aaqibatu littaqwaa
ayahs.en: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا يَاۡتِيۡنَا بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖؕ اَوَلَمۡ تَاۡتِهِمۡ بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي الصُّحُفِ الۡاُوۡلٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo law laa yaateenaa bi Aayatim mmir Rabbih; awalam taatihim baiyinatu maa fis suhufil oolaa
ayahs.en: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ اَنَّا٘ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ بِعَذَابٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ لَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡتَ اِلَيۡنَا رَسُوۡلًا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰيٰتِكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ نَّذِلَّ وَنَخۡزٰي
ayahs.tl: Wa law annaaa ahlaknaahum bi'azaabim min qablihee laqaaloo Rabbanaa law laaa arsalta ilainaa Rasoolan fanattabi's Aayaatika min qabli an nazilla wa nakhzaa
ayahs.en: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوۡاۚ فَسَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ اَصۡحٰبُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ اهۡتَدٰيࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul kullum mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasta'lamoona man Ashaabus Siraatis Sawiyyi wa manih tadaa
ayahs.en: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
